notes.title: New Server "Equilibrium" and update 8.0.1 "Creation" are live!
notes.notes:
Update 8.0.1 Creation has been successfully installed and is now available for download! In addition, we have launched "Equilibrium" - a new Allods Online server with triple bonus on killing monsters. Until August 1st, we invite you to participate in the server’s grand marathon, where you will also receive awesome prizes for leveling up your character: level 8 Runes, a riding Furnace, and many other valuables!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25238866/65746ae4c4d452e1861b07e30e656f1493a5b639.png

Legendary proficiency will be replaced with a new type of equipment - an artifact which grants your character unique abilities and passive bonuses. For now, 3 artifacts will be available for all players, and the first of them will be automatically given to everyone who has collected at least two items of fabled quality, required to unlock the legendary bonuses, in the previous mini-season.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25238866/dc12cbbe0b05073651c032479ba293e0c6be2541.jpg

Components for crafting and upgrading artifacts can be obtained in raid adventures, while the rest of the equipment - all of it - is now obtained on Astral allods. Also, killing all four bosses on an allod is now additionally rewarded, so fighting until the very end is now always a better choice than to desert!

The new story chapter will acquaint you with the lifestyle of the Aoidoi and give you a chance to participate in the great Dionic Games - the Sarnautian version of the Olympic Games. “The Observatory” raid will allow you to travel through space and time and contribute to the epic battles of the past!

Apart from all that, we have launched new arenas for the Trial of Blood, changed the rating calculation principle for Mazes on your personal allods, and provided the option to join a random skirmish together with your friends - and that is just the half of it!

You can check out the full list of changes via the link below -- enjoy!
https://allods.my.com/en/update-801-creation-patch-notes

notes.title: Update 7.0.2: "Blazing Skies" – Now Live!
notes.notes:
Dear Sarnaut,

7.0.2 "Blazing Skies" is now live, throwing many tweaks, changes and content your way, starting with the continuation of the story – the final confrontation with the architects! Check out our trailer for a small taste of what to expect:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zeplhysqhE8

Feel free to check out the full list of changes via our 7.0.2 Patch Notes, or refer to the summary below if you prefer a more manageable overview of tweaks, changes and content.

►   7.0.2 – Daily Gifts

►   7.0.2 – Raid Search

►   7.0.2 – Maze Update

►   7.0.2 – Combat Training

►   7.0.2 – Overall Summary

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25238866/7f5d0fe5a7a28d196a8451b0ddf32c087e8b47c5.png

We hope you enjoy the update and wish you the best of luck in your new adventures!

notes.title: 7.0.1 "Unconquered Summit" Release Date!
notes.notes:
Dear Sarnaut,

We're pleased to announce that 7.0.1 “Unconquered Summit”, the next Allods update & mini-season, is hitting your screens on Thursday, August 4th – bringing a flexible new raid, various tweaks and improvements, multiple Allods to explore, astral activities to enjoy, and the continuation of the current story.

How will the League & Empire's allegiance fare against the new challenges that await?

Missed out on all the changes heading your way? Don't worry, we've got you covered!


    7.0.1 New Storyline Chapter & Adventure
    7.0.1 Gearing Up - How To
    7.0.1 Brand New Allods
    7.0.1 Astral Activities


We wish all Sarnautian adventurers the best of luck in this brand new chapter.

If you took part in the "Guess the Release Date" mini-contest, you can check out the results right here – congratulations to the winners!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25238866/d87cebfc274d20ea047312c6406546959f45be7b.png
